title: refactor(components): share logic between refinement and menu components
body:
> This is a big PR, mainly due to the types, snapshots and previously missing tests. I can try to split it in several PRs to make the review easier.

This refactors the widgets depending on the previous `RefinementList` component:

* `RefinementList`
* `HierarchicalMenu`
* `Menu`
* `NumericMenu`
* `RatingMenu`

## Impact

It will be easier to implement "Show More" and "Search For Facet Values" behaviors in their corresponding widgets.

They are also now typed with TypeScript.

## Dependencies

We now have a main component called `List` that handles:

* SearchBox
* Facets display
* No results display
* Show more

This is the component that all other list widgets use.

`HierarchicalMenu` and `SharedRefinementList` directely uses this `List` component. `SharedRefinementList` provides the primitives to build a refinement list experience. `Menu`, `NumericMenu` and `RatingMenu` use `SharedRefinementList`.

```
- List
  - HierarchicalMenu
  - SharedRefinementList
    - RefinementList
    - Menu
    - NumericMenu
    - RatingMenu
```
